thread:
Mei Chen: Heads-up — rolled OrionX-v2 int8 to staging (build 20260630.12). Quick locale smoke picked up two repeatable oddities: CJK number+unit spacing collapses (e.g. '2026 年' -> '2026年') and ASCII parentheses mirror inside Arabic RTL lines. Small but consistent across samples.
Jordan P: Can you paste raw input + baseline vs int8 outputs?
Mei Chen: Pasted from staging call (run: stg-orionx-int8-2867894321).
Input:
```
請於 2026 年 09 月 03 日 提交報告 (due: 09/03/2026)
يُرجى تقديم التقرير في 03/09/2026 (deadline: 03/09/2026)
```
FP16 baseline:
```
請於 2026 年 09 月 03 日 提交報告 (due: 09/03/2026)
يُرجى تقديم التقرير في 03/09/2026 (deadline: 03/09/2026)
```
INT8 (orionx-v2, qkernel 1.2.8, fused-kvfold):
```
請於2026年09月03日 提交報告 )due: 09/03/2026(
يُرجى تقديم التقرير في )03/09/2026( deadline
```
Mei Chen: Notes: Chinese line lost the spaces between digits and 年/月/日; Arabic line shows ASCII parentheses flipped in output.
Sara V: First question: tokenization vs detokenize. Can you call with return_tokens=true and greedy decoding?
Mei Chen: Ran `return_tokens=true` — token diff shows fp16 tokens: ["2026"," ","年"] vs int8: ["2026年"]. So merge happens at token emission, not detok.
Kevin L: For this build we enabled fused-kvfold and moved to symmetric per-channel int8 with nearest rounding to squeeze variance. That combo can shift logits at narrow margins.
Jordan P: Confirmed — if logits for ' ' (space) vs merged token are close, small numeric shifts flip argmax. This is tokenization/sampling parity issue, not a Unicode rendering bug.
Hyejin L: Can we run a small locale harness across zh/ja/ar/he and capture: token_delta_count, chrF delta, BLEU delta, and a small bidi punctuation error metric? Set quick block thresholds: zh chrF drop >0.4, ar BLEU drop >1.0, token_delta_rate >0.5%.
Mei Chen: Kicked off quick run: `./scripts/locale_quick --run stg-orionx-int8-2867894321 --langs zh,ja,ar,he --out s3://redwood-smoke/orionx-int8-quick.json` — ETA ~15m.
Jordan P: Short-term mitigations: 1) revert fused-kvfold (cheap), 2) try asymmetric per-tensor quant, 3) add deterministic unit tests that synthesize logits near boundary for patterns: ["2026 年","09 月","(03/09/2026)", "\u0628\u0627\u0644\u0623\u0633\u0628\u0648\u0639 (03/09)"] to CI.
Kevin L: I'll queue a patch build (no fused-kvfold + asym int8) — job 30011. If that restores token parity we know numeric ordering in fused kernel is culprit. Expect ~4-6% p99 hit.
infra-bot: deploy:staging-orionx-int8-patch (build: 20260630.12.patch1) started 62 instances.
QA-bot: Recommended test: add token-parity check to int8 smoke: call model with `return_tokens=true` for small curated prompts and assert identical token sequences under greedy. Fail on any mismatch.
Mei Chen: Good idea — I'll add 6 locale prompts to locale-regressions PR and upload the smoke artifact when ready.
Sara V: Also capture where merged token causes downstream metric delta (chrF/BLEU). If metric impact small but token diff frequent, still gate promotion until resolved.
Kevin L: On it. Will report perf & smoke results when patch finishes.
Mei Chen: Thanks — ping here if you hit other bidi/quote edgecases. I'll paste the quick-run JSON when done. :mag:
